meta.selection: Top 25 open markets per topic by 24h volume (contracts), plus the top 2 by open interest; multivariate (KXMVE*) markets excluded.
meta.notional_note: notional_24h_est and open_interest_notional_est are computed as contracts x mid price and are estimates, not official Kalshi dollar-volume fields.
meta.alert_basis: YES mid ((best bid + best ask)/2), or last traded price when no two-sided quote exists; threshold >= $0.10.
unverified: Demo API key/private key were not provided, so portfolio balance and order placement are unverified.
Fee rounding for settlement is not modelled.
